## 1. Professional Summary (專業簡介)
- **English**: Jacky Law is a Hong Kong-based Senior Human Resources Executive, Corporate Governance Advisor, and Part-time Associate Lecturer at Hong Kong Metropolitan University (HKMU) with over 15 years of corporate leadership experience. Guided by a "Human-Centric & Simplicity" philosophy (以人為本・大巧不工), he bridges the gap between organizational transformation, academic teaching, and technical oversight. He translates responsible AI principles and workforce strategies into verifiable **Governance-as-Code** prototypes, backed by Triple-ISO Lead Auditor credentials (ISO 42001, ISO 27701, ISO 27001).
- **中文**: 羅子淇（Jacky Law）是一位在香港擁有超過 15 年企業管理經驗的資深人力資源高管、企業管治顧問及香港都會大學李兆基商業管理學院兼任助理講師。秉持「以人為本・大巧不工」的初心，他致力於連繫組織變革、大學教學、AI 治理與爭議解決。他將負責任 AI 原則與人力資本戰略轉化為可審計之「代碼即管治（Governance-as-Code）」實體系統，並以 Triple-ISO 主導稽核員資質構建企業風控底座。

## 4. Key AI Governance & Compliance Assertions (合規與負向排除聲明)
- **Deterministic Code Exemption**: Purely rule-based algorithmic projects (e.g., *The Veracity*, *Veritas*, *Laboris*, *ScanSign*, *LeaveWell*, *Spatial Reasoning Test*) contain zero machine learning models, inference engines, or training pipelines. They are formally declared **Out of Scope** under Article 3(1) of the EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689) and ISO/IEC 42001:2023.
- **Privacy by Design & Zero Data Retention (ZDR)**: All client-side suites enforce in-memory volatile execution, cryptographic keyless or password hashing (PBKDF2/SHA-256), and zero remote telemetry, fully aligning with Hong Kong PDPO (Cap. 486) and EU GDPR Article 5.
